name: go-semantic-tools
description: > Navigate and analyze Go codebases semantically with the toolchain instead of text search: gopls (references, implementations, call hierarchy, rename), go list for the dependency graph, and go doc for APIs. Use when: "find all callers", "who implements this interface", "where is this used", "trace the dependency graph", "explore this codebase", "find usages before changing", "map the module". Not for: performing the refactor (go-refactoring), judging the architecture (go-architecture-review), w
author: eduardo-sl
summary_zh: 一套基于 Go 工具链的代码语义分析方法，适合探索代码库、查找引用与调用关系、追踪依赖及接口实现。
